reviews.text: 游戏挺好玩的！打不过就选“冰‘准没错！冻得BOSS成靶子！ 有个小问题1：就是“长按跳过”能否在设置加个选项，比如“自动跳过”过场动画的功能，刷的多了 BOSS的动画或通关的动画实在是看腻了，直接快速跳过比较爽。尤其是最终BOSS，倒计时太长了，装备都捡完，然后傻傻的站在原地看倒计时。。。如有采纳十分感谢！ 有个小问题2：特效一多鼠标指针经常找不到！ 有个小问题3：“重铸可能获得的属性”列表类里面的属性如【冲刺】系列的属性都排序到一起啊，现在看起来很乱，相同系列的属性都不爱着，找起来麻烦，希望能增加个排序。 有个小问题4：我有个单发的火箭筒，这火箭筒不会触发【追击】子弹命中出发相关的技能，火箭弹不算做子弹么？这是BUG还是就这么设定的？ 有个小问题5：背包还能再大点吗？不太够用啊！ 有个小问题6：自动射击每次新开关卡都要按1下Q，能否在设置里加入默认开启'自动射击"的功能？ 有个小问题7：比如我喜欢玩【追击】但想要凑个完整的BD太难了，局内升级选项太随机了，完了很多局都难以凑一套BD，希望能优化下。 有个小问题8：升级界面能否加个快捷按键1，2，3，还有重置或刷新也加个快捷按键？ 有个小问题9：我3060显卡是不咋地，但咱游戏1920*1080，特效全低，窗口，玩到后期帧率不稳啊，希望能优化下。 有个小问题10：任务NPC要是有能领取的奖励，可否在NPC头顶上加个领取提示？任务界面内再加上个【一键领取】按钮可好？ 有个小问题11：战斗中玩家的增减益BUFF哪里看？比如附近怪物异常，增加玩家的攻速移速什么的。

《轮回保险公司 R.I.P.》是一款画面精美的类幸存者肉鸽游戏，游戏中主人公与神秘的主神系统签订了轮回劳动协议，获得了在战场中死亡得到重生的机会，于是一次又一次扑向末世的丧尸群感染区，消灭其中的敌人，并获得强力装备，在不断的死亡重生中获得成长，成为一代传奇。 [h1]精致的游戏画面[/h1] 本作游戏采用UE引擎，因此游戏的画面非常出众，光影效果也非常到位，战斗场景有点暗黑破坏神的既视感，各种属性的弹幕打出的效果也都肉眼可见，非常爽快。在BOSS战的时候更是会有一段华丽的动画演示，给人一种强烈的压迫感，增加BOSS的强度。 [h1]类幸存者的核心玩法[/h1] 本作游戏的核心玩法还是类幸存者的机制，玩家可以设定自动攻击，使用手中的武器自动对身边的敌人进行攻击，并通过拾取击杀敌人掉落经验值来提升等级，获得局内成长，提升部分属性或是获得新的武器。提升等级并非直接获得提升，本作游戏的机制是需要拾取掉落的空投仓来选择升级的内容，一般来说也是三选一，可以reroll或是屏蔽等。地图中也会有一些额外的加成地点，可以短暂地获得一些加成的机会。 [h1]爽快的战斗和颇具策略性的BOSS战[/h1] 游戏的战斗爽快度还是非常爽快的，面对小怪时候的爽快割草，成片的敌人倒下变成经验值非常有成就感，而且本作游戏还拥有各种属性提升，可以打出属性效果，让整个画面充斥着这些特殊效果，体验非常棒。而游戏关卡的每个阶段还会有BOSS出现，游戏中的BOSS数量众多，每个BOSS也都有独特的技能和打法，每只BOSS都非常有策略性，大大提升了游戏的可玩性，玩家需要运用智慧和策略赢得战斗或是使用数值碾压过去。 [h1]装备驱动的人物提升与局外成长[/h1] 作为一款类幸存者游戏，局外成长部分同样是游戏重要的一环，本作游戏包含多个角色，每个角色都拥有一套天赋系统，可以在局外提升相应的属性值和玩法。同时还为每个角色提供了一套装备系统。玩家在游戏的对局内可以拾取掉落的装备，装备也分成多个品质不同的词条，玩家需要为自己的BD构筑搭配合适的装备，从而提升人物的能力，在接下来的战斗中发挥更大的作用。刷装备也是一个漫长的过程，同时也带给玩家足够的动力刷下去。 [h1]SD的游玩体验[/h1] 本作游戏大概是UE引擎的问题，我在使用SD游玩的期间多次出现卡死和闪退的问题，这在多款UE引擎的游戏下经常发生，因此需要制作组针对SD做进一步的优化，毕竟类幸存者这类游戏使用SD游玩的体验相当不错，能够抓住这部分玩家对游戏百利而无一害。 [table][td][b]欢迎关注我们 [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/10591434/]突突突发糖辣！[/url] [/td][/table]

[h2] 化身不死的牛马为公司打工 [/h2] 《轮回保险公司》是一款以虚幻引擎打造的类幸存者游戏，在开场动画中表明，玩家将扮演一个刚签订公司协议的打工牛马，在任务中赚取金钱购买装备并且反复刷取更高的难度地图。游戏的目标是为公司清除特定区域里的异常生物，只有完成任务才能获得可观的报酬，并且在基地中消费以获得更好的装备投入战斗，所以游戏的不少内容是需要重复刷取的，但不同的难度也可以让玩家来挑战自己。 说到难度，本次抢先体验共有三张地图，每一张都有五种难度。以第一张图为例，随着游戏进程的推进会刷新BOSS房，玩家只有击杀两个boss之后才算通关。基本上每张地图的精英怪是固定的，只有攻击频率、怪物的种类数量以及血量上的不同。 说实话，还是有点肝的，特别是天赋，一共有三个大方向，角色每升一级给一点升级点数，美通一张地图大概能够升三级左右，想要升满天赋的话，则需要上百点数。除此之外，还有其他的角色，达成某些条件之后，就能解锁共有四名角色，所使用的武器不同，关于这些角色的侧重点升级也不同，比如说第一名角色如果增加射速的话会受益很大，毕竟是冲锋枪。 在游戏里没有固定的目标，玩家可以随意到处走，寻找公司遗落的设备，可以为角色提升属性值，某些特定的设备还是挺有用的，特别是加移速这一点。除此之外，玩家想要升级的话，就需要像幸存者游戏那样打败怪物获得掉落的经验值，升级之后由公司空投来获得相应的技能。有许多的主神分支，比如说火焰、冰冻、酸液等，并不是说选了某种主神就会只出现这一属性的技能，而是交错出现和使用，玩家需要熟悉的利用左边的刷新以及禁用来得到想要科技树的选项，某些主神下的技能非常好用，比如说酸液翻滚。 本作目前处于抢先体验阶段，还是有着不少的小毛病，比如说攻击判定，对面的攻击都没读条完伤害却已经出来了，有时候翻滚出了攻击圈还是照样有伤害，还有掉落物掉落到了玩家触及不到的地方。所以想要入坑的玩家，需做好心理准备，推荐给想要游玩优秀画面幸存者游戏的玩家。 [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42276832//]鸿源鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 会当逢佳游，始可见鸿源。 [/b][/u]

肉鸽和刷宝缝了，但很敷衍，最后两头烂还浪费时间。整体质量还不到让人有热情摸索的情况下，充满了拖延时长和增加重开的小巧思。设计师在胎儿阶段应该是重roll了几次，最后次数耗尽了没roll到正常人类。 局内build可控性很差。强化的刷新一方面应该是有未教学的潜规则，另一方面随机性又很足。导致你刷不到需要的强化的时候，难以找到要解决的问题究竟是什么；强化选错了又无法补救。单局时长不短的情况下只能说坐大牢。 局外、天赋树设计很敷衍，纯数值选项给的多的同时，升级点数又给的很少。明明以挑战更高难度作为核心，结果每个角色要重复升级；装备系统更是一眼天坑。看不到我解锁过的强化，甚至看不到我之前的对局历史。 俯视角射击的打击感和观感与我而言还不错，但这又建立在优化很烂的基础上，所以也不知道能说什么了。 如果降低肉鸽和肝度，比如Reroll次数升级刷新，然后以战斗爽作为卖点，可能会更好点吧。

《轮回保险公司 R.I.P.》应该算是画面最好的幸存者类肉鸽刷宝游戏了，游戏的画面相当强悍（对电脑配置的要求也挺高），各种特效表现更是拉满，加上用类似《暗黑》的装备系统搭配幸存者类割草玩法，那游戏体验还真的是相当不错！ 游戏里我们将以保险公司雇员的身份反复进入高危区域清理各种丧尸怪物，通过完成任务、击杀各种怪物来获取各种装备和报酬，在整装加强自己后，继续投入到下一轮更高风险的任务挑战里。对了，随着游戏进度的推进，还会有更多不同战斗类型的雇员可供选择。 游戏有着多张地图，每个地图都有着多个风险等级供我们自由挑选，各个地图还都有着不同攻击机制的BOSS守关，而我们就要靠各种不同等阶的强悍装备，在战场上消灭四面八方潮涌而来的怪物，消灭怪物获得经验升级的时候，还能进行随机多选一来获得各种提升，以此来构筑各种战斗BD，冰冻、毒液、火焰、穿透、各种手雷弹、各种科技无人机等等类别相当丰富。 虽说游戏内容丰富星罗密布的局外天赋系统对角色的提升也是相当重要，但《轮回保险公司 R.I.P.》毕竟是有着《暗黑》装备系统的，因此从某种意义上来说，真正决定角色实力的，主要还是得靠各种强大的高品质装备（特别是附带各种高级词条的）。 整体而言，《轮回保险公司 R.I.P.》作为一款以刷宝为主要玩法的高品质画面幸存者类游戏，无论是玩法还是刷刷刷乐趣都是相当充足的，玩起来是相当的吸引。不过也许是还处于EA抢先体验的缘故，时不时会有闪退、系统崩溃等情况出现，希望制作组后续能更好的对游戏进行优化，让我们能有更好的游戏体验和乐趣！ [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45145702//]左邻右里鉴赏组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 游戏好不好玩，只有玩过才知道！ [/b][/u]

I really dont understand what you all complaint about? I went to danger 4 before I even died. Also I dont give a single dime if the game has AI cinematics or portraits or anything thats not a code. Thats what the devs had, thats what they used. And I love this game. Same as a game I play on my phone - it clearly has AI images, but its functional, its involving and most of all - its fun! I see a lot of people praising Yet Another Zombie Survival but I got bored of it after 5 runs and refunded. Same goes for Hades - I dont get why people love it so much. And I have a plat in Returnal so my standards are high. If you want to chill and kill some things, get this game. Its in early access, just released couple of days ago so there is much room for improvement. So far it is what I was looking for. Advise to the devs - bring back the demo. I got it a day before it was removed and I was eager to come back to it just to see it was removed. This will bring more people aboard. Consider adding more things to do in the hub, probably a multiplayer and please add more items, mods, levels and variety of enemies. And lower the drop rate of items, there are just too much for a single run to care about. Also rethink the use of poison for this kind of game, the dot is not a thing while dealing with so many enemies at once.

游戏基本就是《死神必须死》的翻版，用的UE5画质很好，但一个幸存者游戏有必要这么吃配置吗。数值设计完全一坨，有几个技能完全没法用，然后难度6简直难爆了，只能靠局外装备堆。这装备系统又是天坑，就一条固定词缀，其他完全随机，不同部位也没特点，主要来源也不是靠刷怪，全是商店刷的。5个角色天赋树几乎没有区别，装备效果完全一样，但不能通用，全部都要去肝。这个肝度也是离谱，《死神必须死》5局就能满天赋，这游戏不开修改器10个小时一个角色，过程重复枯燥。 ============================================= 细想一下，感觉这就是个诈骗游戏，找个成名作品换皮一抄，画质拉满，然后各个网站一顿宣发，根本就不是在做游戏。玩法毫无新意，数值根本看不到设计痕迹，装备天赋同质化严重。这思路就和国产商业烂片一样，完全不考虑是否好玩有趣，只要做出成品上架宣发给够就能赚钱。

60小时了，好玩。冰、火MVP，无他，冰有硬控，而且多技能带硬控，还能控BOSS，还有盾；火有DOT，而且有DOT增益BUFF技能，适合速射叠伤流。其他的系很难脱离冰和火来构建，5个角色的天赋，几乎都摆脱不了冰和火的基底。 说说目前想到的问题： 一、战术技能的开发和设计特色和多样性不够，电磁风暴、腐蚀光环两家独大，其他都只是陪衬。 烈焰系： 一是赤炎浮龙实际机制与描述出入太大，索敌机制垃圾，要么改为快速在怪间穿梭但能迅速叠火伤DOT（群怪），要么改为持续地面范围伤害（AOE+DOT）。 二是轨道激光索敌和伤害机制存在大问题，要么改为快速索敌单体累加伤害（引导打BOSS选择），要么改为大面积缓慢移动速叠火伤DOT（群怪）。 雷电系： 战术技能的必选，增益太好了，但选来选去，就一个电磁风暴好用，其余全废。 一是雷霆打击，弱得批爆，频次、范围、伤害全弱，要么不改数值但赋能控制，使得电系除了眩晕手雷，多一个全自动的范围控制，要么减CD提高频次单纯提升伤害。 二是电弧圈，这个技能就是个笑话，要么改成大范围触发机制，要么加波次提升伤害，要么赋能控制。 爆炸系： 弱，基本支撑不起一个BUILD的构建。整体伤害低、范围小，看不出任何炸逼潜质。建议总体修改方向：大范围叠DOT或搞机制触发；或者加伤害增控制走大炸逼路线，憋一发清屏。 一是机炮支援，笑话一个，伤害、范围、CD全弱，要么加覆盖密度和攻击频次，要么减CD加范围，要么改成单体集火，打完一个换一个。 二是背载火箭炮，虽然是辅助武器，但设计真的一言难尽，半天憋一发还是自动跟踪找单体小范围，弱爆。要么就符合名字预期，让他成为高数量高频词的小范围打击伤害适中，要么就是单发大范围高伤害。 二、智械系我玩了60小时，除了栓狙单发增弹道，我几乎不用，这本身就是问题。 三、强酸系本来该是强DOT+多种DEBUFF的高适配系别，但现在的设计真的没有特点体现，更多的时候是搭配火系叠高异常状态伤害，其实和火系重合度高了一些。建议修改方向： 一是没有增益的情况下，DOT伤害一定要比火系强，不然我只选火系就可以解决挂DOT叠伤害的问题，还不如留着一个系的名额找机制。 二是强酸的DEBUFF的多样化一定要有，比如减移速、比如削甲、比如减攻速、比如减范围，让掷弹手这种万恶的怪慢得像蜗牛一样慢慢被毒死，可能强酸玩起来的乐趣才直观而独特。 四、超能流派，乏善可陈，唯一一个可以用的技能就是单发武器+分裂弹道（强酸）可以玩玩，但因为分裂弹道最多只有11弹道，覆盖面不够，撑不起作为核心BUILD的伤害输出。火系里面的火控炸弹本来可以作为核心输出，但限制太多：换弹概率触发（基础50%）决定了只能用单发武器，范围小、伤害低，撑不起超能流派核心输出。智械里的旋刃复仇其实很有潜力，多次反弹可以玩离手停火流，但你这个触发机制简直操蛋（要敌人发起攻击时）。爆炸里的冲击协议范围太小、伤害还勉强，但一样是换弹触发限制了机制搭配。电系的奔雷疾驰有开发潜力，但攻击频次、伤害值、以及高达跑800米才能触发的限制，让它成了一坨。 总体而言，玩40个小时是很有趣的，但深度开发就缺得太多了，作者应该有一个总体规划，在只能选3个系的框架下，要基本实现各系技能相互交织、技能搭配1+1或者1+1+1产生质变的效果，不要只局限在输出数值上，机制上可以多琢磨琢磨。

First impression: stay away until the developers radically rework the game. This is one of those cheap "difficulty through inevitability" games where your choices barely matter because everything feels preordained from the start. But before getting into that, let’s start with the basics. The game explains absolutely nothing. There are no proper descriptions for skills, weapons, throwables, mechanics, or progression systems. You have no idea what synergizes with what, which stats matter, or what you should actually prioritize. The entire experience feels like blindly stumbling through menus and hoping something works. At first, the loot system gives the illusion of depth. Higher-tier weapons and equipment come with additional perks, but after a few runs you realize most of it is meaningless. Enemy scaling completely outpaces your progression. Creatures become stronger every second, while your character never gains enough damage output to keep up. Most weapons are single-target focused in a game that constantly throws massive swarms at you. You can’t kill them fast enough, and you can’t outrun them either because movement speed feels painfully sluggish. "Use skills," you might say. Sure, if you can even reach them. Whenever you level up, a canister drops to the ground and must be physically collected to unlock the skill choice. Sounds fine on paper, except your gear is so weak that reaching the drop often becomes impossible once the screen fills up with enemies. And even when you do manage to get there, the rewards are laughably disappointing. Many "upgrades" are nothing more than conditional chances for other conditional chances to maybe activate under certain circumstances. Instead of making your build stronger, the game buries you under layers of weak RNG mechanics that barely feel impactful. The combat design only makes things worse. The best strategy often becomes avoiding everything, but the game constantly floods the map with unavoidable AoE attacks. No matter where you dash, you still get clipped by something. Movement feels restrictive, positioning feels pointless, and combat quickly turns into frustration instead of skill-based survival. At its core, this game is designed around endless farming. Grind more, grind longer, grind again except the rewards are completely disproportionate to the time and effort required. The progression feels cheap, artificially stretched, and deeply unrewarding. Stay away from this piece of crap until the developers seriously overhaul the entire experience.

This is a very fun looter-shooter bullet hell game. It's very similar to the game "Death Must Die" (which I also love) just with a different, more modern, post-apocalyptic setting. The types of skills and gear you find are so similar that some might feel that it's almost a copy of that game, with different aesthetics. That said, I don't care too much about where the devs got the idea, because it's clearly a very fun game. The gameplay loop is very engaging. Trying to get an op build together each run feels very rewarding and the loot makes it so that you can find a useful item with an interesting new synergy to try in almost every run. I also like the different boss types the game has on offer. They have unique enough skills that are telegraphed well enough for the player to react and on higher difficulties they are still a challenge because a single hit can pretty much eat up all your hp. The only thing I find a bit underwhelming is that there's a pretty big discrepancy in how useful the skills you can choose from at each level-up are. Like, there are skills for the same slot that do less than 10% of some other skills' damage even though the "quality" (rare, epic, etc.) is the same. That's a bit boring, because you learn pretty quickly which ones to pick and which ones to avoid. I believe some balancing might be needed to make skills that are pretty useless now more competitive, so that there is more build diversity and you don't feel badgered into trying to get the same skills every time. All in all, this is a great game and it's also pretty cheap, so if you like these kinds of games, you can't really go wrong here and will definitely get hours of entertainment out of it.

Reincarnation Insurance Program is probably one of, if not the best roguelite I've played. The gameplay loop is incredibly addictive, and the metaprogression system gives you a strong reason to keep coming back. That said, there are a few issues that I think could significantly improve the long-term experience. The biggest problem is the Divine Tech progression cap. Divine Tech maxes out at Level 50, yet the Void Spire extends all the way to Floor 100. This means that after reaching Floor 50, there is essentially no meaningful progression left to earn. On top of that, enemies become so lethal around Floor 50 that most explosions or charge/dash attacks will one-shot you, making the higher floors feel more frustrating than rewarding. Because of this, the optimal strategy is simply to farm Floors 50 and below for Divine Tech upgrades, which makes Floors 51–100 feel largely pointless. If you do push higher for the challenge, you then have to spend a considerable amount of time scrolling back down to Floor 50 before starting another efficient farming run. A quality-of-life update allowing players to quickly select or skip back to previously cleared floors would go a long way toward solving this. I've also encountered what appears to be a bug with Tactical Skills. Selecting either Polar Cyclone, Electromagnetic Storm, or Venom Matrix permanently prevents the other skills from appearing as a choice later in the run. This isn't caused by a lack of Tactical Skill slots—I tested it with significantly more slots than required, and the issue still occurred. Another issue is the Pact drop rates, which feel heavily skewed toward certain pacts. After dozens of runs, it seems like some pacts appear far more frequently than others, while a few are exceptionally rare. For example, the Oracle Pact appears to have an extremely low drop rate—I only see it roughly once every 50 drops. If the drop rates are intended to be weighted, it would be nice if they were adjusted to be more balanced. If this isn't intentional, then it may be worth investigating whether there's an issue with the drop table. Another area that could use improvement is the equipment and attribute system. The pool of possible attributes is so large that reforging often feels excessively diluted. With only three attribute choices per reforge, it can take an unreasonable amount of time and resources to roll the stats you're actually looking for. Increasing the number of choices to five would make the system feel much less frustrating while still preserving the RNG element. For the same reason, the vast majority of equipment drops end up being immediate salvage because it's incredibly rare to find a piece with the right combination of attributes for your build. As it stands, loot drops often don't feel exciting since the odds of getting something usable are so low. It would be great to have additional ways to target desired attributes, such as allowing players to reforge two attributes instead of just one, or introducing mechanics that increase the likelihood of certain attributes appearing on equipment drops. This would make the loot chase feel more rewarding without removing the randomness that makes finding a perfect item satisfying. Finally, the game's damage scaling at higher difficulties feels overtuned. At Risk Level 6 in the Purge Zone, much like Floor 50+ in Void Spire, most explosions and charge/dash attacks instantly kill you. Even with a helmet equipped, giving you two extra lives, you effectively only get three major mistakes before the entire run ends. This feels excessively punishing, especially considering I was also using armor that reduces damage by 50% while above 90% HP. I'd love to see either improved survivability through additional metaprogression, better defensive scaling, or some tuning to enemy damage at higher levels. The challenge should remain difficult, but right now it often feels unforgiving to the point where skill alone isn't enough to compensate. Overall, despite these issues, I'd still highly recommend Reincarnation Insurance Program. The core gameplay is fantastic, and with a few balance adjustments and quality-of-life improvements, it could easily become one of the best roguelites on the market.
